description: Kubernetes image tags only - Dependabot already covers the Dockerfile, pyproject/uv.lock and GitHub Actions, but has no Kubernetes manager. This repo's own image (ghcr.io/lukislp/studylife-telegram) is written into k8s/ by the deploy-bump job on every release and is excluded here, so the two never compete for the same tag. That currently leaves nothing to update - k8s/ carries no third-party image yet - and this config exists so the first sidecar or init container added there is picked up without anyone having to remember to wire it up.
